records.title: Rainbow Padding: Mitigating Early Termination in Instruction-Tuned Diffusion LLMs
records.reason: Rainbow Padding fixes premature EOS/short-output behavior in instruction-tuned diffusion LLMs by changing padding-token training. It improves accuracy and length robustness but restores longer outputs and reports no inference cost reduction; link to efficiency is weak.

records.title: Decoupling the "What" and "Where" With Polar Coordinate Positional Embeddings
records.reason: The primary abstract centers on positional embeddings for transformer representation; it does not propose or evaluate a direct LLM inference improvement in compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, offload, or serving.

records.title: Distilled Pretraining: A modern lens of Data, In-Context Learning and Test-Time Scaling
records.reason: Distilled pretraining improves pass@k/diversity at similar pass@1 (GSM8K pass@16 27% vs 23%) but is a quality-versus-multiple-attempts result, not lower per-query cost; more attempts may raise compute and ICL can degrade.
